facts.fact: The Government of Cabo Verde launched the Portal de Justica on 18 December 2024, offering online land, commercial, vehicle and criminal-record certificates, civil-registry certificates and national ID card renewal, with sign-in through the state Autentika platform.

systems.system: Portal de Servicos Publicos Digitais Integrados do Estado

facts.fact: The Consular Portal, funded by the World Bank Digital Cabo Verde project, digitized consular services for the diaspora and cut processing times for electronic documents by 85%.

note: Only a pillar of public digital services is stated, with no service named.

systems.system: Portal Único de Serviços Públicos Digitais

note: The single public services portal is only under construction; Portal da Justiça is named without its services.

facts.fact: The Government of Cabo Verde launched the Foreign Trade Portal on 17 November 2023, with a vehicle-clearance simulator and customs process tracking, as a first step towards about 42 business services online by 2025.

note: The minister names implementation of the Single Portal of State Digital Services as a 2026 priority; no portal or service is stated as launched.
A decree-law amendment only allows visa applications through a digital platform; no platform launched or piloted is stated.

facts.fact: Caboverde24 reports that Cabo Verde's Gov.cv portal, launched in February 2026, offers about ten services analysed, including online criminal record requests, nationality requests and higher education applications, plus order tracking.

The author, a former NOSi manager, says Casa do Cidadão life-event public services came to be accessed multichannel, notably through the PortondinosIlha portal, with online certificates among the systems built; no count of services is given.

note: Database line only: transactional portal portondinosilhas.gov.cv, already held.
